name: access
sql: CREATE TABLE access(customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(category IN ('items_stock','pricing','orders_quotes','account')),enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(customer_id,category))

name: branch_stock
sql: CREATE TABLE branch_stock(item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),branch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES branches(id),available INTEGER NOT NULL,on_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,next_receipt_on TEXT,source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(item_id,branch_id))

name: branches
sql: CREATE TABLE branches(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,name TEXT NOT NULL,address TEXT NOT NULL,city TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,zip TEXT NOT NULL,lat REAL NOT NULL,lng REAL NOT NULL,will_call_phone TEXT NOT NULL,will_call_hours TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT)

name: contacts
sql: CREATE TABLE contacts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),name TEXT NOT NULL,title TEXT,phone TEXT,email TEXT,is_primary INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT)

name: contract_lines
sql: CREATE TABLE contract_lines(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,contract_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contracts(id),item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),unit_price REAL NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price>=0),source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT,UNIQUE(contract_id,item_id))

name: contracts
sql: CREATE TABLE contracts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),contract_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,name TEXT NOT NULL,starts_on TEXT NOT NULL,ends_on TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT,CHECK(ends_on>=starts_on))

name: conversations
sql: CREATE TABLE conversations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),contact_id TEXT REFERENCES contacts(id),started_at TEXT NOT NULL)

name: customer_prices
sql: CREATE TABLE customer_prices(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,price_level_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES price_levels(id),item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),unit_price REAL NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price>=0),source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT,UNIQUE(price_level_id,item_id))

name: customer_rep
sql: CREATE TABLE customer_rep(customer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES customers(id),rep_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reps(id))

name: customers
sql: CREATE TABLE customers(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,account_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,name TEXT NOT NULL,terms TEXT,credit_limit REAL,open_balance REAL,past_due_balance REAL,tax_status TEXT CHECK(tax_status IN ('taxable','exempt')),tax_state TEXT,price_level_id TEXT REFERENCES price_levels(id),main_phone TEXT,ship_to_name TEXT,ship_to_address TEXT,ship_to_city TEXT,ship_to_state TEXT,ship_to_zip TEXT,ship_to_lat REAL,ship_to_lng REAL,source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT)

name: delivery_rates
sql: CREATE TABLE delivery_rates(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,base_fee REAL NOT NULL CHECK(base_fee>=0),per_mile REAL NOT NULL CHECK(per_mile>=0),min_charge REAL NOT NULL CHECK(min_charge>=0),free_threshold REAL NOT NULL CHECK(free_threshold>=0),max_radius_miles REAL NOT NULL CHECK(max_radius_miles>0),road_factor REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.25 CHECK(road_factor>=1))

name: departments
sql: CREATE TABLE departments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,branch_id TEXT REFERENCES branches(id),phone TEXT NOT NULL,email TEXT,hours TEXT NOT NULL,sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: items
sql: CREATE TABLE items(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,sku TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,description TEXT NOT NULL,category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_categories(id),pack TEXT NOT NULL,case_qty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(case_qty>=1),cost REAL NOT NULL CHECK(cost>=0),list_price REAL NOT NULL CHECK(list_price>=0),keywords TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT)

name: messages
sql: CREATE TABLE messages(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('customer','assistant','system')),kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text',content TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

name: meta
sql: CREATE TABLE meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

name: order_lines
sql: CREATE TABLE order_lines(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),line_no INTEGER NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),qty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(qty>0),unit_price REAL NOT NULL,unit_cost REAL NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT,UNIQUE(order_id,line_no))

name: orders
sql: CREATE TABLE orders(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,order_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),quote_id TEXT REFERENCES quotes(id),po_number TEXT,order_date TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('open','shipped','closed')),fulfillment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(fulfillment IN ('will_call','delivery')),branch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES branches(id),shipped_on TEXT,tracking_number TEXT,subtotal REAL NOT NULL,freight REAL NOT NULL,tax REAL NOT NULL,total REAL NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT)

name: price_levels
sql: CREATE TABLE price_levels(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,name TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT)

name: product_categories
sql: CREATE TABLE product_categories(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT)

name: query_logs
sql: CREATE TABLE query_logs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,question TEXT NOT NULL,categories TEXT NOT NULL,handled_categories TEXT NOT NULL,tool_calls TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',row_count INTEGER NOT NULL,latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,outcome TEXT NOT NULL,answer TEXT NOT NULL,timestamp TEXT NOT NULL)

name: quote_activity
sql: CREATE TABLE quote_activity(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,quote_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,at TEXT NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(actor IN ('customer','querent','rep','system')),actor_id TEXT,kind TEXT NOT NULL,message TEXT NOT NULL)

name: quote_lines
sql: CREATE TABLE quote_lines(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,quote_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,line_no INTEGER NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),qty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(qty>=0),unit_price REAL,price_basis TEXT CHECK(price_basis IN ('contract','customer','list','last_paid','custom')),suggested_price REAL,suggested_basis TEXT CHECK(suggested_basis IN ('contract','customer','list','last_paid','custom')),customer_price REAL,unit_cost REAL NOT NULL,explanation TEXT,requested_text TEXT,match_score REAL,added_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'querent' CHECK(added_by IN ('querent','rep','upsell')),UNIQUE(quote_id,line_no))

name: quote_notes
sql: CREATE TABLE quote_notes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,quote_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,rep_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reps(id),body TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

name: quote_removed_lines
sql: CREATE TABLE quote_removed_lines(quote_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,line_no INTEGER NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),requested_text TEXT,match_score REAL,added_by TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(added_by IN ('querent','rep','upsell')),removed_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(quote_id,line_no))

name: quote_revisions
sql: CREATE TABLE quote_revisions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,quote_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,sent_at TEXT NOT NULL,sent_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reps(id),message TEXT,attach_pdf INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,total REAL NOT NULL,snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(quote_id,revision))

name: quotes
sql: CREATE TABLE quotes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,quote_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),contact_id TEXT REFERENCES contacts(id),rep_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reps(id),status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ready_for_review','sent','accepted','changes_requested','expired')),revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,conversation_id TEXT REFERENCES conversations(id),request_text TEXT,requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,sent_at TEXT,responded_at TEXT,fulfillment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(fulfillment IN ('will_call','delivery')),branch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES branches(id),requested_date TEXT,fulfillment_time TEXT,ship_to_address TEXT,ship_to_lat REAL,ship_to_lng REAL,freight_override REAL,freight_override_reason TEXT,valid_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 14 CHECK(valid_days IN (7,14,30)),valid_until TEXT,expires_on TEXT CHECK(expires_on IS NULL OR expires_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),customer_po TEXT,customer_note TEXT,change_request_note TEXT,unread_for_rep INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,unread_for_customer INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,is_sample INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,duplicated_from TEXT REFERENCES quotes(id))

name: rep_category_floors
sql: CREATE TABLE rep_category_floors(rep_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reps(id),category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_categories(id),margin_floor REAL NOT NULL CHECK(margin_floor>=0 AND margin_floor<1),updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(rep_id,category_id))

name: reps
sql: CREATE TABLE reps(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,initials TEXT NOT NULL,title TEXT NOT NULL,phone TEXT NOT NULL,email TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'seed',external_id TEXT,synced_at TEXT)

name: settings
sql: CREATE TABLE settings(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

name: sqlite_sequence
sql: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

name: suppliers
sql: CREATE TABLE suppliers(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,address TEXT NOT NULL,city TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,zip TEXT NOT NULL,phone TEXT NOT NULL,email TEXT NOT NULL,website TEXT NOT NULL)

name: sync_events
sql: CREATE TABLE sync_events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,timestamp TEXT,message TEXT)
